subject: OneTrust onboarding — evidence runway and SSO access
messages:
From: Rebecca Chen <rchen@onetrust.com>

Cc: Jon Kaplan <j.kaplan@acmepay.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding kickoff & checklist for Acme Payments (OneTrust)

Hi Naomi,

Great to meet you in the call last week. To keep momentum, I put together a short onboarding checklist and a recommended intake cadence so Acme can complete the portal profile for SOC 2 / SIG intake. Attached: OneTrust_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — it has section owners and suggested evidence names.

Two quick asks to get SSO set before the kickoff (Wed):
- Please add security@redwood-inference.com as a portal admin for the Acme workspace so we can upload evidence.
- Share your SAML metadata or the IdP entity ID; we support Okta/AzureAD/GSuite SSO.

Proposed timeline (subject to your change):
- Tue: portal admin access + SAML
- Wed 10:00 AM PT: 30-min kickoff (internal + Acme)
- Thu-Fri: evidence staging and sample uploads

If you want, I can pre-stage common SIG artifacts (network diagrams, SOC 2 cert) under a read-only folder so Acme can link them.

Thanks,
Rebecca
Onetrust Customer Success
OneTrust

Attachment: OneTrust_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

> Karthik: please scope the minimum evidence set we need to upload for initial SIG/L1 review (network diagram, SOC 2 summary, encryption key management doc). Ben, can you prepare the SOC 2 artifact (PDF) and point to the latest storage bucket where logs are archived?

Thanks Naomi. For L1 SIG intake I'd recommend these minimum artifacts:
- high-level network diagram (PDF)
- SOC 2 Type II report + cover letter (PDF)
- CAIQ answers export (CSV/MD)
- key management summary (1-2 pages)
- sample access control policy (PDF)

Ben — our logs live in gs://redwood-prod-logs/retention/90d; I'll add a read-only signed URL for the upload manifest. I'll put the Okta metadata in a secure drive link (shared with Rebecca).

Karthik
Sr. Cloud Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
